hook.en: Hands-on strokes, kneading and pressure on muscle and soft tissue to relax it, improve circulation and improve movement.
hook.ur: Soft-Tissue Mobilization ek broad category hai bodye longitudinal strokes, kneading, sustained pressure, skin rolling aur tissue gliding shamil ho sakte hain.

goal.en: By the end, you'll know what Soft-Tissue Mobilization is, when it's safe and useful, how to apply it step by step — and how to prove it worked. (3 checks along the way.)
goal.ur: End tak aap jaan jayenge ke Soft-Tissue Mobilization kya hai, kab safe aur faida-mand hai, qadam ba qadam kaise apply hoti hai — aur kaise prove karein ke kaam kiya. (Raste mein 3 checks.)

text.en: Soft-tissue mobilization is the skilled use of strokes, kneading, compression and friction on muscles and tendons. You adjust depth, speed and direction by how the tissue and the patient respond.
text.ur: Is category mein mukhtalif manual contacts shamil hain, jaise lambi direction mein strokes, kneading, sustained pressure, skin rolling aur tissue gliding.

simpler.en: Hands-on strokes, kneading and pressure on muscle and soft tissue to relax it, improve circulation and improve movement.
simpler.ur: Soft-Tissue Mobilization ek broad category hai bodye longitudinal strokes, kneading, sustained pressure, skin rolling aur tissue gliding shamil ho sakte hain.

text.en: Like working dough. Gentle, steady kneading softens it; harsh pounding just bruises it.
text.ur: Jaise aata goondhna. Narm aur musalsal goondhne se woh naram hota hai; zor zor se maarne se sirf chot lagti hai.

text.en:
Three ideas carry this whole technique:
**1.** Match pressure to tissue state and pain level, not to how hard you can push.
**2.** Warm up with light strokes before deeper work.
**3.** Always check the effect on movement or pain afterward.
text.ur: Mumkin asraat mein short-term pain modulation, muscle tone, mehsoos hone wali stiffness aur movement tolerance mein tabdeeli shamil hai. Pressure aur speed tissue ki irritability aur patient ki preference ke mutabiq honi chahiye. Clinical endpoint function mein behtari hai, na ke therapist ke fingers ke neeche koi khaas sensation.

question.en: Vocabulary first — clinicians use this word a lot. What does **Effleurage** mean?
question.ur: Pehle vocabulary — clinicians yeh lafz bohat use karte hain. **Effleurage** ka matlab kya hai?

text.en: Long, gliding strokes used to warm up and finish.
text.ur: Long, gliding strokes used to warm up and finish.

feedback.ur: Qareeb hain, lekin yeh **Petrissage** ka matlab hai. **Effleurage** ko dobara parhein aur phir koshish karein.

text.en:
So when does **Soft-Tissue Mobilization** make sense?
• Muscle tension, soreness or stiffness limiting movement.
• Preparing tissue before exercise or stretching.
• Recovery after training.
text.ur: Muscle tightness ka ehsaas; myofascial pain; movement ya exercise se pehle warm-up ke taur par.

text.en:
And just as important — when you should NOT use it, or should stop:
• Deep vein thrombosis, infection, open wounds, fractures or severe bruising.
• Areas of unexplained lumps or swelling.
• Pain that rises sharply.
text.ur:
Asani se bruising, sensory loss, varicosities ya recent injury.
Khula zakhm, infection, DVT, acute compartment syndrome ya unstable fracture.

title.en: How to do it — 6 steps, each with its reason
title.ur: Kaise karein — 6 qadam, har ek ki wajah ke saath

steps.title: Assess and explain
steps.detail: Look at the area, ask about pain, and explain what you will do.

steps.title: Position comfortably
steps.detail: Support the area so the muscle relaxes.

steps.title: Warm up
steps.detail: Use light effleurage in the direction of the muscle.

steps.title: Deepen gradually
steps.detail: Add kneading or compression, asking about comfort.

steps.title: Target tight spots
steps.detail: Use friction or sustained pressure briefly.

steps.title: Finish and retest
steps.detail: Return to light strokes, then retest movement.

beats.ur:
1. Region ki screening karein aur baseline movement note karein.
2. Target aur patient ke comfort ke mutabiq contact ki depth aur direction choose karein.
3. Response monitor karte hue slow ya rhythmic mobilization apply karein.
4. Zaroorat ho to broad contact se zyada specific contact ki taraf jayein.
5. Dobara assess karke active movement follow karein.

question.en: Imagine the patient is in front of you. What do you do FIRST?
question.ur: Farz karein patient aap ke saamne hai. Aap SAB SE PEHLE kya karenge?

text.en: How much? Typical teaching range: 5-15 minutes for an area, with moderate pressure the patient finds 'good-sore', not painful. Adjust frequency to recovery.
text.ur: Maqsad aur irritability ke mutabiq ek region par aam tor par 2–10 minutes lag sakte hain. Aise high pressure se bachein jo bila-zaroorat lambi soreness paida kare.

beats.patient: Tariq, 33, cyclist, tight right calf after a long ride.
beats.assessment: Calf is tender and tight, ankle dorsiflexion limited; no signs of a clot or tear.
beats.treatment: You warm up with long strokes, knead the calf for six minutes, then apply compression to a tight spot.
beats.reassess: Dorsiflexion improves and soreness lessens. He follows with a gentle calf stretch.
beats.ur:
Ek misal se poora clinical flow dekhein:
Farz karein exercise se pehle patient ko thigh mein tightness mehsoos hoti hai. Screening ke baad clinician comfortable soft-tissue contact use karta hai aur phir squat ya doosri relevant movement dobara check karta hai. Yeh sirf concept samjhane ki misal hai.

text.en:
The mistakes I see most often:
• Using the same pressure on every patient.
• Pressing on a possible blood clot.
• Ignoring pain signals.
text.ur: Har tightness ko adhesions kehna, uncomfortable pressure ko effective samajhna aur functional retest skip karna avoid karein. Patient ke symptoms aur chosen movement ko pehle aur baad compare karein.

answer.en: Suspected clot, infection, open wound or fracture.
answer.ur: Suspected clot, infection, open wound or fracture.

text.en: Massage and soft-tissue work give short-term relief for pain and tension in several conditions. Benefits are modest and temporary and are best combined with active care.
text.ur: Soft-tissue techniques ka effect technique, condition aur outcome ke mutabiq vary karta hai. Temporary symptom change ko tissue permanently lengthen ya repair hone ka proof na samjhein.

text.en: One line to carry into the clinic: **Warm up, deepen gradually, retest.**
text.ur: Pressure ka maqsad clinically useful hona hai, patient ki pain tolerance ko test karna nahi.
